levels.surface: عبد الملك بن شعيب بن الليث بن سعد

notes: The chain stops at Salim. Ibn Umar's renting is described (not a link). Rafi' and Ibn Umar speak inside the story («فقال رافع لعبد الله» / «قال عبد الله فلقد كنت»): which speaker is the last link is not settled by rule 6, so the ruling is needed
«أرسله شعيب بن أبي حمزة» names a different transmitter who omits the Companion (mursal): a variant group, not a route
